heading: Master of Science (MS) in Computer Science
subtitle: GPA: 3.88/4.0
content: Studied a comprehensive range of topics in Computer Science, including Computational Biology, Algorithms, Software Engineering, Programming Languages, Database Management Systems, Parallel Programming, Computer Graphics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing.
Under Prof. Liang Huang, developed novel linear-time algorithms for RNA Structure Prediction, and refactored existing codebases by adding new features to enhance performance and scalability.

Developed a dynamic programming algorithm for RNA alignments, enhancing efficiency with beam pruning and supporting calculations for partition functions, base pairing probabilities, and structure predictions (MFE, MEA and Centroid).

Developed 6 web servers hosting various RNA algorithms, and optimized existing frontend & backend of the web applications leading to improved SEO, which contributed to a 500% increase in traffic, thereby enhancing the accessibility and utility of our scientific findings.
Conducted office hours for multiple Algorithm courses, helped with grading assignments and provided feedback to over 300 students, and assisted in course design.

heading: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science
subtitle: GPA: 8.5/10.0
content: Gained a solid foundation in key areas of computer science such as Discrete Mathematics, Data Structures, Algorithm, Theory of Computation, and Programming Languages.
Gained comprehensive knowledge in Operating Systems, Database Management Systems, Computer Networks, and Computer Graphics, integrating system-level understanding with practical applications.
Delved deeply into Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Neural Networks, developing a nuanced understanding of cutting-edge technologies and their practical implementations.

Conducted five workshops on machine learning, introducing core concepts and practical applications. Facilitated as part of the Google-sponsored Explore ML program, enhancing machine learning awareness among university students.
Developed strong analytical and problem-solving skills through hands-on projects and coursework.
Engaged in various extracurricular activities, including workshops and technical events, to enhance my understanding of emerging technologies and industry trends.

heading: Artificial Intelligence Nanodegree
subtitle: Certificate Link | GitHub Link
content: Learned AI techniques including classical search, constraint satisfaction problems, and local search optimization.
Gained experience in adversarial search (Minimax, Monte Carlo Tree Search) and probabilistic reasoning with Hidden Markov Models.

heading: Machine Learning Engineer Nanodegree
subtitle: Certificate Link | GitHub Link
content: Mastered supervised learning techniques (Regression, KNN, Random Forest, SVM) and unsupervised learning (Clustering, GMM).
Gained proficiency in data preprocessing, including data cleaning, normalization, feature engineering, and applied PCA for high-dimensional datasets.
Developed expertise in Deep Learning (CNNs) for image classification and Reinforcement Learning (Q-Learning, DQN, Actor-Critic, DDPG) for autonomous decision-making in complex environments.
